$comment: One entry per Supabase project. NO SECRETS HERE. `envVar` names the GitHub Actions secret (or local env var) that holds that project's IPv4 pooler connection string. Onboard a new project = add an entry here + add the matching secret. `sampleTables` are optional schema-qualified tables to read row-counts from (guarded; a missing table is harmless). Set `enabled:false` to park a project without deleting it.
